name: configforge
description: ConfigForge — Cross-platform Electron desktop app for OSConfig security baseline authoring

scripts.desktop:build: npm run core:build && npm run build -w @configforge/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run core:build && npm run dist -w @configforge/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run core:build && npm run dist:win -w @configforge/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run core:build && npm run dist:linux -w @configforge/desktop
scripts.desktop:e2e: npm run desktop:build && playwright test --config apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts
